_note: Synthetic regional pest bulletin, shaped like a county plant-health alert. dayOffset is relative to the fixture 'today' and is shifted to the real date at seed time.

alerts.summary: Late blight (Phytophthora infestans) confirmed on three farms in the upper zone after a week of wet mornings; protectant sprays advised on crops before maturation.
Fall armyworm egg masses reported on young maize in the lower parts of the zone; scout whorls twice a week.
Tuber moth catches rising in pheromone traps near stores; hill up ridges and harvest promptly once mature.
